comment:
* Implements the PolicyNode interface. *

* This class provides an implementation of the PolicyNode * interface, and is used internally to build and search Policy Trees. * While the implementation is mutable during construction, it is immutable * before returning to a client and no mutable public or protected methods * are exposed by this implementation, as per the contract of PolicyNode. * * @since 1.4 * @author Seth Proctor * @author Sean Mullan

variables.name: ANY_POLICY
variables.comment: * Use to specify the special policy "Any Policy"

variables.name: mParent
variables.comment: every node has one parent, and zero or more children

methods.name: public String toString()
methods.comment:
* Return a printable representation of the PolicyNode.
     * Starting at the node on which this method is called,
     * it recurses through the tree and prints out each node.
     *
     * @return a String describing the contents of the Policy Node

methods.name: void setImmutable()
methods.comment:
* Sets the immutability flag of this node and all of its children
     * to true.

methods.name: private void addChild(PolicyNodeImpl child)
methods.comment: * Private method sets a child node. This is called from the child's * constructor. * * @param child new PolicyNodeImpl child node

methods.name: void addExpectedPolicy(String expectedPolicy)
methods.comment:
* Adds an expectedPolicy to the expected policy set.
     * If this is the original expected policy set initialized
     * by the constructor, then the expected policy set is cleared
     * before the expected policy is added.
     *
     * @param expectedPolicy a String representing an expected policy.

methods.name: void prune(int depth)
methods.comment:
* Removes all paths which don't reach the specified depth.
     *
     * @param depth an int representing the desired minimum depth of all paths

methods.name: void deleteChild(PolicyNode childNode)
methods.comment:
* Deletes the specified child node of this node, if it exists.
     *
     * @param childNode the child node to be deleted

methods.name: PolicyNodeImpl copyTree()
methods.comment:
* Returns a copy of the tree, without copying the policy-related data,
     * rooted at the node on which this was called.
     *
     * @return a copy of the tree

methods.name: Set<PolicyNodeImpl> getPolicyNodes(int depth)
methods.comment: * Returns all nodes at the specified depth in the tree. * * @param depth an int representing the depth of the desired nodes * @return a Set of all nodes at the specified depth

methods.name: private void getPolicyNodes(int depth, Set<PolicyNodeImpl> set)
methods.comment:
* Add all nodes at depth depth to set and return the Set.
     * Internal recursion helper.

methods.name: Set<PolicyNodeImpl> getPolicyNodesExpected(int depth, String expectedOID, boolean matchAny)
methods.comment: * Finds all nodes at the specified depth whose expected_policy_set * contains the specified expected OID (if matchAny is false) * or the special OID "any value" (if matchAny is true). * * @param depth an int representing the desired depth * @param expectedOID a String encoding the valid OID to match * @param matchAny a boolean indicating whether an expected_policy_set * containing ANY_POLICY should be considered a match * @return a Set of matched PolicyNodes

methods.name: private Set<PolicyNodeImpl> getPolicyNodesExpectedHelper(int depth, String expectedOID, boolean matchAny)
Set<PolicyNodeImpl> getPolicyNodesValid(int depth, String validOID)
methods.comment: * Finds all nodes at the specified depth that contains the * specified valid OID * * @param depth an int representing the desired depth * @param validOID a String encoding the valid OID to match * @return a Set of matched PolicyNodes

methods.name: String asString()
methods.comment: * Prints out some data on this node.

methodNames: private void getPolicyNodes(int depth, Set<PolicyNodeImpl> set)
Set<PolicyNodeImpl> getPolicyNodesExpected(int depth, String expectedOID, boolean matchAny)
private Set<PolicyNodeImpl> getPolicyNodesExpectedHelper(int depth, String expectedOID, boolean matchAny)
